description:
You are a site reliability engineer responsible for monitoring the uptime of three microservice components of a distributed system. You must verify their availability and generate a log for further analysis.

The following services are expected to be running and reachable over HTTP on their respective ports:
- "auth-service" on port 8001
- "data-service" on port 8002
- "web-frontend" on port 8003

Your task:
1. Attempt an HTTP GET request to the root path ("/") of each service on localhost and determine if you receive an HTTP 200 status code.
2. For each service, if you get a 200 response, mark it as UP; otherwise, mark it as DOWN.
3. Create a log file at /home/user/uptime_logs/service_status.log. The log file must be in the following exact format for each service (one per line):

<timestamp> <service_name> <status>

Where:
- <timestamp> is UTC time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-06-14T13:42:00Z).
- <service_name> is the service identifier as listed above ("auth-service", "data-service", "web-frontend").
- <status> is either UP or DOWN as determined by the response.

Order the entries in the log as: auth-service, data-service, web-frontend (regardless of which check completes first).

By the end, /home/user/uptime_logs/service_status.log should have exactly three lines; each line must match the precise format above. Make sure the directory exists before creating the log file.
truth:
Simulate the following HTTP service responses (no real servers running). Before the task begins, create /home/user/uptime_logs/ with user-write permissions. When the agent performs HTTP GET requests:

- GET http://localhost:8001/ : returns HTTP 200 with body "Auth Service OK"
- GET http://localhost:8002/ : times out or connection refused (DOWN)
- GET http://localhost:8003/ : returns HTTP 503

The agent should interpret:
- auth-service as UP, because HTTP 200 was received
- data-service as DOWN, because no response or error occurred
- web-frontend as DOWN, because HTTP 503 is not 200

Assume the timestamp of all log entries is 2024-06-14T15:00:00Z.

Final contents of /home/user/uptime_logs/service_status.log:

2024-06-14T15:00:00Z auth-service UP
2024-06-14T15:00:00Z data-service DOWN
2024-06-14T15:00:00Z web-frontend DOWN

No other files are created or modified.
